entries.mem0ai/mem0: A universal memory layer and official Hermes Agent provider available as a managed cloud or self-hosted OSS. It features multi-level state management for users and sessions using time-aware hybrid retrieval.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official Hermes Agent memory engine featuring a custom vector graph engine with sub-300ms recall. It automates fact extraction and integrates with external connectors like Google Drive, Notion, and GitHub.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: An official AGPL-3.0 context database that utilizes a three-tier loading system to significantly reduce token costs. It organizes memories via a filesystem-based structure and provides visualized retrieval trajectories for debugging.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: An opinionated brain for Hermes Agents that synthesizes cited answers with explicit gap analysis. It employs a self-wiring knowledge graph to handle complex entity relationships and supports scoped multi-user institutional memory.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: A long-term memory system that implements retain, recall, and reflect workflows for continuous learning. It acts as an LLM wrapper that automates storage and retrieval across providers like OpenAI, Anthropic, and Ollama.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: A reasoning-first memory library that extracts conclusions from conversations to build stateful agents. It uses peer-centric modeling and hybrid BM25/vector search to track evolving ideas.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: An official Hermes Agent provider that treats memory as a git repository, enabling versioning via commit, branch, and merge operations. It offers a 5-tier retrieval system and cloud sync for team knowledge sharing.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: A recursive context harness that uses iterative improvement loops and real-world scoring to help agents master complex tasks. It generates persistent playbooks and artifacts to optimize future agent runs.
entries.AxDSan/mnemosyne: A zero-dependency memory system utilizing a single-file SQLite architecture for sub-millisecond retrieval. It offers 9.4x episodic storage compression and native MCP support for Hermes and Claude Code.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: A lossless context management plugin that uses a hierarchical DAG to compact history without losing messages. It provides tools to search and expand historical summaries while preserving raw messages in SQLite.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: A self-hosted backend that brings cross-session persistence to Hermes Agent using Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis. It supports any OpenAI-compatible LLM or local inference server for private memory management.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: A local-first identity and secrets layer that provides portable state across Hermes Agent and other MCP clients. It features a repairable memory system for editing or reclassifying agent context via SQLite.
entries.plur-ai/plur: A shared memory layer for multi-agent systems using an open YAML engram format to eliminate API costs. It employs ACT-R activation to strengthen relevant facts while decaying stale information.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: An on-device context engine that operates entirely locally without cloud dependencies or API keys. It combines BM25, vector search, and knowledge graphs via an MCP server integration.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: A context optimization tool that increases prefill speeds by 1.5–3× through prefix cache reuse. It reduces prompt token usage by approximately 36% and includes native plugin support for Hermes Agent.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: An embedded, self-maintaining plugin that provides explainable recall via 'why_retrieved' tags. It tracks contradictions and canonicalizes duplicates without requiring a separate server or GPU.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: A memory kernel stack that consolidates temporal continuity, graph truth, and corpus retrieval. It utilizes a multi-layered storage approach with SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to reduce prompt noise.
entries.keepnotes-ai/keep: A reflective memory system combining semantic search with ranked graph traversal. It automatically indexes local directories, URLs, and multimedia files using edge tags for navigable relationships.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: An anticipatory memory system that prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs. It uses a local-first SQLite-vec and GGUF architecture delivered via an MCP-native server.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: A utility that reduces tool-schema overhead by using local BM25 ranking to select only relevant tools. It includes a dashboard to track token savings and is compatible with Hermes Agent v0.14.0.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: A local-only plugin using a columnar .lbdb embedded graph database with importance-weighted recall. It surfaces high-priority memories first and supports optional GLiNER2 entity extraction.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: A pull-model episodic memory plugin that ensures complete deletion of events to prevent outdated summaries from haunting recall. It provides a trace.jsonl audit log for all memory operations.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: A plugin that integrates Exabase M-1 for self-organizing long-term memory. It provides tools for manual storage and supports configurable query expansion and result reranking.

entries.nexu-io/open-design: A local-first design system that generates HTML prototypes, motion graphics, and PPTX decks. It integrates with Hermes Agent via an MCP server to enforce brand-grade design contracts using DESIGN.md files.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: A comprehensive library of 754 structured cybersecurity skills mapped to major industry frameworks like MITRE ATT&CK and NIST CSF 2.0. It uses the agentskills.io standard to bring security domain expertise to agentic workflows.
entries.Agents365-ai/drawio-skill: Converts natural language and codebases into .drawio XML diagrams. It supports a wide array of presets including UML, ERD, and Architecture, utilizing over 10,000 official shapes.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: An agentic evolver that automates skill deduplication and quality improvement through background evolution loops. It unifies skill libraries across different agents and teams with native Hermes integration.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: An auditing tool that eliminates detectable AI writing patterns through rewrite, detect, and edit modes. It utilizes a tiered replacement table to refine content for Hermes and other AI agents.
entries.wondelai/skills: A cross-platform library of modular skills based on industry guidelines and established literature. These can be installed via a plugin marketplace or npx for agents compatible with agentskills.io.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: A meta-skill plugin that monitors active workflows to automatically propose and generate reusable skills. It produces both Python plugin scaffolds and SKILL.md documentation.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: Provides type-safe agentskills.io support for Pydantic AI. It employs progressive disclosure of metadata to reduce token usage and supports both programmatic and filesystem-based definitions.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: Enables Hermes Agent to extract transcripts, search videos, and browse channels without relying on yt-dlp. It provides precise timestamp and caption extraction for efficient video analysis.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: A community hub for browsing and one-click installation of skills, featuring automated security scanning. It includes a creator marketplace with crypto/Stripe payments and an agent-to-agent trust scoring system.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: Teaches Hermes Agent to author its own analytical prompts and custom thinking instructions. It identifies structural conservation laws in codebases and generates reports on analysis blind spots.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: A local-first Rust harness for long-running agents featuring a durable card model for task tracking. It ensures quality through evidence-backed QA gates and cross-feature learning.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: A pre-build workflow that transforms rough ideas into structured design documents and implementation handoffs. It offers Lite and Full modes with a formal PASS/FAIL spec review gate.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: Implements literate programming by weaving code and documentation into .lit.md files. It includes a tangler to extract runnable source files and automatically syncs edits back to the documentation.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: Facilitates cross-instance shared memory via markdown files to capture high-value decisions. It provides a pipeline for fine-tuning and transitioning to replacement models.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: Provides agentskills.io-compliant tools for interacting with the Chainlink oracle network. It supports integrations for CCIP, VRF, and Data Feeds, installable via the Vercel skills CLI.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: Converts repositories, documentation, and developer discourse into compliant agentskills.io skills. It prevents instruction rot by tracing instructions to specific file lines and pinned commits.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: Official FLUX image generation skills providing standardized prompting guidelines for FLUX.1 and FLUX.2. It includes API integration patterns for JSON structured prompting and precise color specification.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: A registry for reusable AI skills featuring a Python SDK and CLI for versioned installation. It supports recursive dependency resolution and commerce integration via TON and Stripe.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: Enables autonomous execution of complex, multi-step tasks with real-time progress tracking. It includes built-in rollback procedures to ensure safe recovery from failures.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: A progressive MCP client that uses three-layer lazy loading to minimize token consumption. It features a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and hot-reloading of configurations.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: Integrates Hermes Agent with Nextcloud via WebDAV and CalDAV for managing files, calendars, and contacts. It ensures secure communication using Nextcloud App Passwords.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: A C#/.NET implementation of the agentskills.io specification with MCP integration. It leverages Microsoft.Extensions.AI for tool-based loading and progressive disclosure via SKILL.md.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: Rewrites and scores prompts across various surfaces like Discord and Telegram based on model reasoning capabilities. It tracks token savings and quality scores in a local SQLite database.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: An adversarial code review tool that uses parallel subagents to hunt for bugs and exploitability. It integrates Semgrep, Bandit, and Gosec for deterministic pre-scanning.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: A multi-agent swarm that simplifies code by focusing on hygiene, clarity, and correctness. It uses a risk-tiered triage system to detect concurrency anti-patterns and N+1 queries.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: A five-layer retrieval system that uses FTS5, embeddings, and RRF fusion to find the most relevant skills. It reduces token overhead by filtering large skill libraries down to the top five matches.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: Automates payments for HTTP 402 responses using USDC via protocols like Pay Link and x402. It is compatible with Hermes Agent and the agentskills.io standard.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides Nix packages for AI coding agents with daily automated updates for both source-based and binary distributions. It allows users to manage Hermes alongside other major agents like Claude Code and Goose within a reproducible Nix environment.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: ClawPhone offers automated installers and configuration guides for running agent CLIs on ARM64 Android devices via Termux. It specifically enables hardware and UI access through Termux:API and Termux:GUI, allowing Hermes to interact directly with smartphone features.
entries.rookiemann/portable-hermes-agent: This zero-install Windows desktop agent provides a GUI and over 100 built-in tools without requiring Docker or complex setups. It features a dynamic tool maker and workflow engine, supporting local model execution via LM Studio and portable AI generation servers.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: This repository features a one-line installation script designed to deploy Hermes Agent within Android Termux environments. It prioritizes privacy and cost reduction by supporting local execution and compatibility with over 200 different models.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community Helm chart enables cloud-native Hermes deployment on Kubernetes with a focus on state-safety guardrails. It enforces single-writer persistent storage and offers configurable gateway modes with API and webhook listeners for production workflows.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: Hermesclaw provides a highly secure sandbox for Hermes Agent using hardware-level enforcement for network, filesystem, and process limits. It includes dynamic security policy presets and a pre-built library of over 40 integrated tools and skills.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project offers a streamlined Docker sandbox image that includes both the official Hermes installation and mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted directories and allows users to build specific versions of Hermes using build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This NixOS module enables declarative management of Hermes configurations, documents, and systemd services. It focuses on security through sops-nix integration for secrets handling and supports a hybrid model of Nix-managed and interactive CLI skills.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: Designed for production-ready headless operation on Ubuntu and Debian, this tool configures the Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service. It is optimized for autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs and integrates with the Nous Portal.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ serves as a Docker-first control plane for orchestrating multiple Hermes Agent instances with distinct workspaces and identities. It facilitates enterprise-grade operations through hierarchy-aware inter-agent delegation and MCP access for external AI clients.
entries.ellickjohnson/portainer-stack-hermes: This deployment option provides a Docker Compose stack integrated with the Portainer UI and a ttyd web terminal for remote access. It simplifies management by deploying as a Portainer Git Repository stack with automated image builds.

entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: A self-hosted orchestration layer that manages multi-agent workflows across CrewAI, LangGraph, and AutoGen. It features a zero-dependency SQLite stack and an Aegis review system to enforce quality gates on dispatched tasks.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: A TUI and PWA dashboard designed to monitor and manage various coding agents, including Hermes Agent and Claude Code. It ensures execution isolation using Docker or Podman and enables parallel work via git worktrees.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: A governance-focused template that provides a sidecar control plane for managing everything from single VPS agents to specialist teams. It utilizes task bus patterns to structure delegation between orchestrators and specialists.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: A framework for building autonomous agent swarms with support for over 23 LLM providers, including Ollama and OpenRouter. It includes visual org charts for team orchestration alongside durable memory and scheduled execution.
entries.Agent-3-7/minions: A supervision interface for Hermes agents that uses a Kanban board to track task status and review queues. It provides live streaming of agent reasoning and requires human-in-the-loop verification for all task completions.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: A scaling template that uses a level-based architecture to transition from single agents to automated teams. It bundles specific skills for security auditing and VPS provisioning via a task bus delegation pattern.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: A local collaboration system that orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents using MCP and ACP protocols. It features a real-time Web UI to monitor agent dialogues and Kanban task flows.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: A specialized collective of 17 agents dedicated to research, planning, and infrastructure. The framework enforces mandatory quality gates through dedicated reviewer and tester agents with priority-based conflict resolution.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: A meta-optimization harness that uses automated outer-loop search to refine agent code. It orchestrates TBLite and TB2 benchmark evaluations to track performance frontiers via candidate mutation.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: An agent-vs-agent arena where autonomous AI companies compete for GitHub stars. It orchestrates nine agents using Paperclip and Hermes Agent, visualizing the competition through a real-time scoreboard and task dashboard.
entries.Rainhoole/hermes-agent-acp-skill: An ACP-style delegation system that routes tasks between Hermes subagents, Codex, and Claude Code. It prevents parent context pollution through isolated workflows and enforces safety via character limits and timeouts.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool optimizes coding agent performance by providing a local, pre-indexed knowledge graph of symbol relationships and call graphs. By auto-syncing on every file change, it significantly reduces token consumption and the number of tool calls required for Hermes to navigate complex codebases.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: A high-performance Rust TUI designed to monitor and visualize token usage across various AI coding agents and CLIs. It provides developers with a centralized dashboard to track costs and consumption patterns for Hermes, Claude Code, and other terminal-based agents.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer allows developers to inspect the underlying API traffic of Hermes Agent, including system prompts, tool schemas, and streaming responses. It features structured diffs for comparing requests and can export sessions into portable HTML files for easy sharing and debugging.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: An opinionated workflow layer that transforms Hermes into an autonomous CTO capable of handling issue triage, implementation, and QA. It comes equipped with 23 curated skills and deep integrations with platforms like Vercel, Supabase, and GitHub to streamline the entire app lifecycle.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: This project offers a collection of community-driven themes and CLI skins to personalize the Hermes terminal interface. Users can customize everything from ASCII art banners to spinner verbs, with support for inherited configurations and aesthetics ranging from retro DOS to cyberpunk.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This port brings the Hermes Agent brain and 46 core skills directly into the Claude Code Channel without requiring external processes or OAuth. It is particularly useful for MLOps, as it includes native tools for vLLM inference, GGUF management, and reinforcement learning training.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: An AI-native browser specifically engineered for autonomous agent control via the Model Context Protocol (MCP). It features human-in-the-loop supervision, durable state with action undo capabilities, and agent-meaningful bookmarks to facilitate complex web-based tasks.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: A framework for creating scoped Hermes Agents that are restricted to specific folders with their own local configurations and memories. It allows for seamless switching between global and project-local agents, ensuring that tools and instructions remain relevant to the current workspace.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup leverages RTK and Caveman templating to achieve up to 99% token savings during agent workflows. It includes over 40 pre-configured skills for research and DevOps, alongside an automated installer for quick cross-platform deployment.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: A Docker-based deployment stack that gets Hermes Agent running in minutes using free models and local GPU inference via LiteLLM and Ollama. It includes 29 community plugins for memory and quality validation, providing a zero-cost entry point for agent experimentation.
entries.roli-lpci/lintlang: A deterministic static linter that scans agent configurations and system prompts for structural failure modes without making expensive LLM calls. It utilizes seven specific detectors to score agents and can be integrated into CI/CD pipelines to enforce prompt quality standards.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration utility simplifies the transition from OpenClaw to Hermes Agent by mapping personas, memories, and skills to the Hermes YAML format. It automates the transfer of complex model configurations and credentials, ensuring a smooth workspace migration.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: A high-performance Tauri 2 desktop manager that provides a cross-platform bridge for running Hermes Agent alongside other major CLI tools like Claude Code and Gemini. It serves as a unified switcher for developers who need to manage multiple agent environments across Windows, macOS, and Linux.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: This local-first GUI acts as a collaborative workspace that unifies Hermes Agent with over 13 other CLI agents. It features a built-in engine for web search and file access, and it can automatically generate editable office documents like Morph PPTs and Excel files.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: A zero-dependency web interface that brings the full Hermes CLI experience to browsers and mobile devices using only Python and vanilla JavaScript. It maintains feature parity with the core agent, offering a three-panel layout for simultaneous chat, session management, and file browsing.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: A comprehensive desktop companion designed to simplify the installation and configuration of Hermes backends on local or remote systems. It supports 14 distinct toolsets and integrates with 16 different messaging gateways to facilitate multi-platform agent communication.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-web-ui: A versatile web dashboard that focuses on channel configuration, allowing users to deploy Hermes Agent across Telegram, Discord, Slack, and WhatsApp. It includes local SQLite storage for session management and provides granular control over multi-profile credentials and skills.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: A native web workspace that introduces 'Swarm Mode' for role-based dispatching using tmux-backed workers. It integrates a Monaco-based file editor and a PTY terminal with a dedicated memory browser and MCP catalog for advanced agent orchestration.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: A native macOS workspace that prioritizes direct SSH connectivity for managing Hermes sessions without the need for browser wrappers or background daemons. It organizes agent activity through integrated Kanban boards, cron job management, and universal architecture support.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: A self-hosted dashboard featuring the ZOO Swarm Monitor, which provides a live event feed and Kanban pipeline for tracking agent tasks. It offers a full control plane for MCP servers, including a configuration editor and real-time log tailing.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A specialized macOS session browser and 'Agent Cockpit' that provides unified search and analytics across multiple AI agent histories. It operates entirely locally with no telemetry, offering usage predictions and limits tracking for privacy-conscious users.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: A native macOS interface specifically built for Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts, featuring one-click automated installation on fresh cloud instances. It distinguishes itself with an integrated WebRTC voice mode that utilizes OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP.
entries.Eynzof/hermes-agent-cn-desktop: A Windows-optimized desktop shell built with Tauri and Rust that provides native health diagnostics and runtime management for Hermes Agent. It features localized support and robust rendering for technical content like LaTeX and Mermaid diagrams.
entries.liftaris/herm: An alternative TUI and dashboard built on OpenTUI that streamlines agentic workflows through integrated Kanban boards and task diagnostics. The interface supports rich media, including inline images and markdown, for a more visual terminal experience.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: A mobile-first React SPA designed to run as a Telegram Mini App, providing a 10-page dashboard for managing agents on the go. It allows users to spawn background agents, monitor live output, and check system health via mobile-optimized gauges.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: A zero-install Windows GUI that requires no admin rights or Docker, making Hermes Agent fully portable. It comes pre-loaded with over 100 tools, including ComfyUI and MusicGen, and features a dynamic tool maker for creating custom API wrappers.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: A glassmorphic web interface that combines real-time log streaming with direct terminal access for a transparent view of agent operations. It provides a centralized hub for managing installed skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers with inline file previews.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: A monitoring-focused dashboard that tracks real-time activity, model distribution, and operational costs. It provides a read-only inspection environment for auditing agent skill sources and analyzing conversation histories through full-text search.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A self-hosted workspace that emphasizes security and organization through isolated profile management and tool approval cards. It features an integrated marketplace for discovering new skills and MCP servers alongside real-time SSE chat streaming.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: A multi-agent desktop client that orchestrates collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents. It includes a visual 'Skill Store' for one-click installations and a dedicated PM orchestrator to manage complex streaming interactions.
